E02's 8.6e-9 STANDS as the (2 pi)-free-convention reading of the same quantity (5.5e-10 x (2 pi)^(3/2) at r_M).  B8's 3.4e-11 (WAVEBOARD.md:1619-1620) is SUPERSEDED: it is n(r_M) x (hbar/(m c_s))^3, a kinematic lambda that is not the thermal de Broglie (B08_condensate.py:198; missing 2 pi and k_B T), 27.5x below the physical Sun value -- all future uses must quote 9.4e-10 (2-pi convention) or 8.6e-9 ((2 pi)-free), never 3.4e-11.
